    ` appears. That directly causes the missing `

    ` wrappers here; I’m removing that heuristic and will use the conformance suite to catch any regression.

item.text: The first fix exposed the intended distinction: the outer list in example 328 is loose, but example 309 must remain tight because its blank line belongs to a nested list. The detector was checking nested markers with their indentation still present, so it misclassified them as direct content. I’m correcting that classification by evaluating the marker after indentation.
